source.quote: As of October 25, 2026, the registrant had 402,714,357 and 19,640,250 shares of class A common stock and class B common stock outstanding, respectively.

notes: Common equity only. Class A trades on Nasdaq as MSTR; Class B (almost all held by Michael Saylor through Alcantara LLC) is unlisted. Strategy's perpetual preferred stocks (STRF, STRC, STRE, STRK, STRD; STRK is convertible into Class A at 0.1 share each) are fixed-claim securities, some in mezzanine equity, and are left out, as are its convertible notes. Share counts rose sharply through 2026 because of at-the-market Class A sales.
